items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps oily-feeling skin fresh without stripping it.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports a comfortable moisture level and a smooth look.
Daily mineral SPF 50 is the most useful step for keeping skin looking youthful over time.

response.routine_note: Cleanse and moisturize morning and night, then apply sunscreen every morning and reapply when outdoors. At 15 your skin scores look healthy, so we left out vitamin C and the firming cream because they are not needed yet and can irritate young skin.
